title: USCGC Stone AC Condensers
agency_path: HOMELAND SECURITY, DEPARTMENT OF.US COAST GUARD.SFLC PROCUREMENT BRANCH 2(00085)
detail_text: This is for informational purposes only. This has been awarded VIA JOTFOC Scope of Work: CGC Stone- Discrep 25082 PR-52000PR260024109 Last update 04/03/26 Background : The #1 A/C Unit failed due to water intrusion throughout the entire the system, rendering it inoperable. Attempts to repair the condenser were unsuccessful. This system is part of the critical loop that helps cool the skiff where crucial sensitive equipment is located as well as providing habitability for the crew. Statement of Work: Vendor to supply two condensers to CGC Stone for repairs. Ketema model MHX12096003, quantity 2 130 ton-chill water unit Service: RDD: 26JUN26 Address: ATTN: STONE (WMSL 758) ENG Dept / AUX / DISCREP 25082 1050 Register St North Charleston, SC, 29405 Key USCG Personnel Information The primary unit POC is Christian Thorn (510) 437-5483 Christian.P.Thorn@USCG.MIL
